caption: MOCK1 supplies scatter/pulse gates; MOCK2 is a transfer acquisition. Scatter-selected singlets are not verified viable cells. Display subsampling does not affect scores.
Control distributions and provisional positivity thresholds. These Mock-only boundaries do not validate multicolor negative spread.
Uniform control-derived rules across all 32 experimental acquisitions; event counts are not biological replicate counts.
Original event means and RAS under team-corrected 75/90 identities; prior 10-to-15 correction retained. n=2 wells/level. Lines are descriptive, not fits.

Same reporter-selected events for all three metrics. A/B are user-confirmed independent transfection wells (n=2 per condition). S7 source label 10 is analyzed as confirmed 15% AC by DNA mass; lines are not calibration fits.

All matched-label pairs are shown; labels mark conditions with higher RAS CV. CV = sample SD (ddof=1) / absolute mean x 100. This is within-experiment independent-transfection-well repeatability (n=2 per condition); independent culture/day replication is not established.

ORCA-P2A-BFP linkage is user-confirmed. At positive editor doses, R+B+ is an exploratory reporter/editor co-expression population; the multicolor B boundary remains provisional. The 1:0 blue tail is a negative-control diagnostic, not editor co-expression.
Predeclared gate, background and threshold perturbations across experimental acquisitions. Boxes describe sensitivity across conditions, not replicate uncertainty.
100 subsamples at each supported event count. Uncertainty is conditional on one acquisition and shrinks to zero at the full finite sample; it is not biological uncertainty.
Bright events remain in the primary score. Red-bin dependence limits any assumption of perfect reporter-expression invariance.
Common B+ range is the intersection of within-acquisition 5th–95th percentiles for positive editor-ratio labels. Low-count bins remain unavailable; profiles do not establish active-editor abundance.

48 AB1 reads / 24 molecular labels / 12 user-confirmed S10 parent wells. Labels 1/2 map to A and 3/4 to B; RNA was extracted after flow. General-design alignment is an identity lead, not exact OpenA or quantitative RNA-editing validation.
Single-point red fluorescence includes negative values. Spatial points are technical positions within a well. No validated plate RAS or flow-to-plate conversion is produced.
